name: Shiomiya Lucia
source: A nun girl from the historic church in Gojou town. She will often wander around town in monastic clothing. Because of her kind personality, she is very well liked in town. Because of her compassion, she cooked for the starving protagonist. Since then, the protagonist refused to leave the church, but she did not mind instead welcomed his arrival.
